title: CBSE Class 10th Second Board Exam Result 2026 – Out
vacancyDetails: Second Board Exam results for Class 10; overall pass percentage for academic year 96.78% after combining Main + Second exams
qualification: Students who appeared in CBSE Class 10 Second Board Exam 2026
selectionProcess: Main Board Exam + optional Second Board Exam → Combined result / DigiLocker marksheet
documentsRequired: Roll Number, School Number, Admit Card ID / DOB as required on DigiLocker result portal
howToApply:
1. Visit https://results.digilocker.gov.in or CBSE results section
2. Select CBSE Class 10 Second Board Result 2026
3. Enter roll number and required details
4. Download digital marksheet from DigiLocker
5. Collect documents from school when issued
shortDescription: CBSE Class 10 Second Board Exam Result 2026 declared on 18 July 2026. Overall pass percentage 96.78%. Check scorecard on DigiLocker results portal.
content:
The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has declared the Class 10 Second Board Examination Result 2026 on 18 July 2026.

Key highlights

  • Overall pass percentage (Main + Second Board combined): 96.78%
  • About 3.08 lakh students improved scores
  • CBSE introduced two board examinations for Class 10 from 2026

Students can access individual results via results.digilocker.gov.in. School-wise results are emailed to schools.
